newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks close higher, further gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks close higher, further gains seen.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed higher on Friday, powered by strength in Endesa and boosted by bonds and other European stock markets, dealers said.
The general index closed up 3.87 points, 0.97 percent, to 404.18. The Ibex-35 index of leading shares ended up 51.08, 1.11 percent, to 4,667.80 in high turnover which exceeded 62.7 billion pesetas.
"The market is very strong and strength in bonds and the dollar indicate that this strength is set to continue," one dealer said.
Activity in Endesa, Telefonica and Repsol's shares accounted for more than 38 percent of total volume.
Traders said strong gains in electricity group Endesa had added a bullish tone to the market and boosted indices.
Gains were attributed to expectations that an upcoming framework for sector regulations would be a non-event. Endesa shares closed 260 pesetas, or 3.06 percent, higher at 8,750.

Regional electricity companies Sevillana and Fecsa, meanwhile, had a volatile day and closed lower after opening higher. Traders cited uncertainty over Endesa's purchase of shares in the two companies as part of a takeover. Sevillana ended down 15 pesetas at 1,215. Fecsa was down 20 pesetas at 1,035.
Telefonica shares closed down 15 pesetas at 2,840 and Repsol ended 95 pesetas higher at 4,795.
